verdict: Paid social is delivering leads below industry cost, but Google Business calls and local reviews are the real engine.
diagnosis: This period produced 585 leads from Instagram ads at roughly $21 each, under the $27 Meta lead benchmark, while Google calls hit 233.

signals.headline: 585 leads generated this period
signals.detail: Instagram ads delivered 585 leads on $12,572 spend. Volume is healthy for a single creative concept.

signals.headline: Cost per lead near $21
signals.detail: Below the $27 Meta benchmark for lead campaigns. The 'Paid Fees, But No Relief?' hook is working.

signals.headline: 233 phone calls from Google Profile
signals.detail: Local search is driving direct calls. This is the highest-intent channel in the mix right now.

signals.headline: 69 new reviews, 4.67 average rating
signals.detail: Strong review velocity this period. Social proof is compounding and lifting local pack visibility.

signals.headline: Instagram following stuck at 42
signals.detail: Organic social is flat. Paid is carrying the channel entirely with no owned audience build.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.subheader: Consumer law lead costs this period
benchmark.body: Meta lead campaigns for legal services average around $27 per lead and a 10.5% conversion rate. Google Ads for legal runs $131 per lead. Justice is well under the Meta figure.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Debt collection complaints rise in fall
seasonal.body: Post-summer credit card balances and holiday pressure push consumers to seek debt relief September through November. Timing favors the current 'harassed by collectors' creative angle.

competitor.label: Category trend
competitor.body: Video ads across Facebook and Instagram outperform static for legal, with CTRs between 1.9% and 3%. Competitors are also leaning harder on Instagram Stories for warm retargeting.

recommendations.title: Test a second video creative against Ad 04
recommendations.detail: One ad is carrying the account. Consider launching a second video with a different hook (job calls, threats) to protect against fatigue and lower cost per lead further.

recommendations.title: Add call tracking to measure Google Profile value
recommendations.detail: 233 calls came from the Business Profile. Worth tracking which calls become cases so local optimization gets fair credit against paid social.

recommendations.title: Build a review request step into intake
recommendations.detail: Review velocity is already strong. Test a text-message review ask after case resolution to keep the 4.67 rating climbing and feed local pack rankings.
